name: 33908 · Fort Myers, FL
findings: ZIP 33908 (Fort Myers) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33908 (Fort Myers) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
